# Seclusion

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

An operational view of seclusion rooms, seclusion and restraint in use, and incidents, ward by ward.

## What is on the screen

1. In use now. Everyone in seclusion or restraint now, longest first. Ward staff record changes on their own ward.
2. Rooms and incidents. How many seclusion rooms are available, and the incidents recorded in the last day.
3. Start seclusion or restraint. Find the patient, choose what is in use, type the time or press Now, then Record start.
4. Record incident. Choose the ward and the kind, type the time, then Record incident.
5. Change a room. Marks a ward's seclusion room available or out of service, for everyone to see.
6. Part of Legal forms. Seclusion is one view of Legal forms. On a form goes back to the forms list.
7. The seclusion rooms. Each secure ward's room, who last marked it and when. Change marks it available or out of service.
8. Ward incidents. Incidents recorded in the last day, by ward and kind. They name no patient.

## Jobs done here

- Record seclusion, restraint or an incident. Open Forms, then Seclusion and restraint. Start seclusion or restraint: find the patient, choose what is in use, type the time, then Record start. Record end on its row when it finishes. Record incident: choose the ward, the kind and the time.
- Mark the seclusion room available or out of service. Open Seclusion and choose the ward. Under Seclusion room, press Mark available or Mark out of service, then confirm. Everyone sees the status, and when it was last marked, until it is marked again.
- Record the end of seclusion or restraint. Open Seclusion and restraint. Under In use now, press Record end on the live episode, type the time it ended and press Save end time. The episode then leaves In use now.

In BedChart, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
